scenes.title: Morning Routine
scenes.description: Minimalist 3D stickman in white body, red hoodie, black sneakers stands at small desk with open laptop, sunlight streaming through window
scenes.characterAction: Wakes up, stretches, checks phone for morning news

scenes.title: The Commute
scenes.description: Stickman walks down simple street with few buildings, city skyline in background, morning traffic
scenes.characterAction: Walks quickly, checks watch, small bus passes by

scenes.title: The Office
scenes.description: Stickman sits at small desk with computer, open notebook, coffee cup
scenes.characterAction: Types on keyboard, smiles, takes sip of coffee

scenes.title: The Work-Life Balance
scenes.description: Stickman sits on chair with coffee cup, looks out window, smiles
scenes.characterAction: Takes deep breath, looks at watch, smiles
